positions.name: Ethereum
positions.catalyst: ETH is the momentum-leading major with the single strongest active positive flow catalyst on the tape: August marked the FIRST month ETH ETF inflows (~$3.87B) overtook Bitcoin's — while BTC ETFs saw ~$750M of net OUTFLOWS. The GENIUS Act stablecoin framework continues to drive settlement-layer demand for ETH (dollar-backed stablecoins issued/custodied on Ethereum), a structural ETH-specific tailwind. Session tape is risk-on: global crypto cap ~$2.27T (+0.7%/24h, ~$52B volume) on Trump/Strait-of-Hormuz de-escalation optimism ahead of Friday's July jobs report. ETH opened ~1,868 and firmed to ~1,881 intraday. Canonical live price 1875.08 (dashboard Yahoo feed, asOf 2026-08-05T15:02:27Z; corroborated by narrative sources putting ETH ~1,868-1,881 today).
positions.driver: Closed prior ETH at 1875.08 (canonical dashboard feed) vs entry 1861.89 for +73.65 (+0.71%) — ETH firmed with the risk-on tape. RE-SELECTED ETH as the best risk-adjusted next-24h pick: it now pairs momentum leadership among majors with a concrete ETH-specific bullish flow catalyst (ETF inflows overtaking BTC for the first time + GENIUS Act stablecoin settlement demand), which is more asymmetric than a purely defensive major hold. Wins vs runners-up: BTC is the safest major but carries a NEGATIVE flow catalyst right now (~$750M ETF outflows) and only modest price gains; SOL has real catalysts (BlackRock tokenized stablecoin reserve on Solana, Agave 4.2 upgrade with 90% rent reduction) but remains stuck in a tight two-week range with no momentum confirmation and higher beta; smaller AI/alt names (TAO, LINK) are less liquid and more speculative. Dashboard price of record used for both fills to avoid phantom P&L. 8% major stop keeps payoff asymmetric.
positions.risks: Fear Index still low (~27) — sentiment is fragile and a risk-off flush (Hormuz talks collapsing, a hot/cold jobs surprise Friday, or renewed geopolitical stress) would drag ETH with the broad tape. ETF-flow leadership is a monthly aggregate, not a guarantee of next-24h price follow-through, and ETH has faded intraday before. Hard stop 1725.07 (-8%).
